title: 12-name watchlist · 07 Nov 2026 (Sat) · 12:00 SGT
summary: No distinct new company development was verified in the checked sources since the prior edition. All 12 November 6 regular-session closes and all 72 adjusted-close baselines were freshly rechecked and are unchanged. Previously covered Google and Meta overlap items are not repeated; earlier research remains available in retained dated reports.
coverage_note: Fixed cutoff: 7 November 12:00 SGT (04:00 UTC). Incremental window: 7 November 07:30–12:00 SGT, with a 30-minute overlap from the previous 08:00 SGT edition. Reuters searches, ten directly retrieved issuer listings and eleven accessible SEC feeds were checked; Micron and Alphabet issuer coverage was search-only. The Google executive board-departure story and Meta Form 4 in the overlap were already covered. No distinct new research item is added. Coverage is partial, and this does not establish that no news occurred. All prior editions, reports and calls remain unchanged.
price_basis: USD regular-session closes for 6 Nov 2026, the latest completed US session at cutoff. Fresh Yahoo Finance daily series and regularMarketTime metadata retrieved 7 Nov 04:00:18–04:00:27 UTC verify all 12 closes. Exact vendor quote timestamps remain 6 Nov 21:00:00–21:00:02 UTC for eleven names and 21:03:23 UTC for BRK.B; each quoted price matches the completed daily bar. Daily changes compare Nov 6 with Nov 5 ordinary closes. Adjusted closes are separate cumulative-return endpoints. Daily-bar timestamps are session labels, not substituted quote timestamps. Postmarket observations are excluded. TSM is the US-listed USD ADR. These saved observations are not live.
return_basis: Six cumulative 1–6 month returns use Yahoo adjusted closes reflecting vendor split and dividend/distribution adjustments. Formula: (endpoint adjusted close / baseline adjusted close - 1) x 100. Source values are rounded to cents before independent Decimal arithmetic; percentages round to two decimals. Baselines are the latest available sessions on or before each monthly anniversary: 6 Oct, 4 Sep, 6 Aug, 6 Jul, 5 Jun and 6 May 2026. Returns are not annualised and exclude investor fees, tax and FX. No independent reconstruction of dividend-adjustment factors or reinvestment model is claimed.
caveats: Reuters coverage is search-based and partial, not an exhaustive wire feed. Search silence does not establish absence of news.

Amazon SEC and Micron IR prior HTTP 403 responses were respected without direct retry. Alphabet IR direct access remains unavailable. Ten other issuer listings and eleven SEC feeds were directly checked.

Issuer listing dates are not treated as exact publication timestamps. Date-only posts were not arbitrarily placed inside the cutoff window. Previously covered events are excluded unless a substantive update is verified.
No new narrative research is included in this edition. Empty research arrays do not erase or invalidate prior dated research, and are not a new bullish or bearish view.

Price and baseline checks use one vendor, Yahoo Finance, without independent cross-vendor corroboration. Vendor split/dividend adjustments are not independently reconstructed. Cents-first arithmetic is reproducible from displayed inputs and can differ slightly from unrounded calculations.
